landing.description: Open-source, self-hosted AI audio workspace for long recordings. Sync your Plaud recordings or upload your own, transcribe with the AI provider you choose, and keep everything on storage you control.
landing.headline: Long recordings, intelligently transcribed.
landing.subhead: Open-source, self-hosted AI audio workspace for long recordings.
landing.featurePlaudText: Imports new recordings from your Plaud account, on a schedule or on demand.
landing.featureChunkingText: Voice activity detection splits multi-hour recordings at natural pauses, so each piece transcribes cleanly.
landing.featureResumeText: Each job keeps its progress. If a run stops, it picks up from the last finished chunk instead of starting over.
landing.featureProviderText: Point OpenAudioHub at any OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint, including a model you host yourself.
landing.featureTimelineText: Read the transcript next to the audio. Select a line to seek, and the active segment follows playback.
landing.featureExportText: Generate AI summaries, export transcripts, and use the public API to connect the tools you already use.
landing.selfHostHeading: Run it on your own server
landing.selfHostBody: Your recordings and transcripts stay on infrastructure you control. The code is licensed under AGPL-3.0.

install.documentTitle: Install OpenAudioHub | Self-host in one command · OpenAudioHub
install.description: Self-host OpenAudioHub with a single curl command. Docker + Compose v2 required. AGPL-3.0, no telemetry, no license server.
install.title: Install OpenAudioHub
install.intro: All you need is a machine with Docker and Compose v2. The installer downloads the release's compose.yml, writes a fresh .env with a newly generated ENCRYPTION_KEY and your APP_URL, starts the stack, and waits for /api/health.
install.pinHint: Replace {tag} with any released tag from the releases page.
install.requirementsList:
Linux or macOS
Docker (any modern version)
Docker Compose v2
Outbound HTTPS to GitHub
install.whatItDoesList:
Verifies Docker + Compose v2
Downloads the current compose.yml for the release
Creates a new .env with a generated ENCRYPTION_KEY and your APP_URL
Starts the stack, waits on /api/health
install.noPipeTitle: Don't want to pipe to shell?
install.noPipeBody: Fair. Read the source at scripts/install.sh on GitHub, or follow the manual self-host instructions in the README. The whole project is AGPL-3.0. Have a look at the source before you run it.
